tools.name: list_product_categories
tools.description: List HTR public product families and the number of website product records. Use this to orient a buyer before searching.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find HTR Bamboo website products by name, specification or category. Supports English and common Chinese product terms. This is not a stock, price or suitability check.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read a product name, source-backed specification tables and quality flags. Preserve table column context and reference-only qualifications. Missing or withheld facts require HTR confirmation.

tools.name: search_procurement_guides
tools.description: Find public HTR buyer guides, sample and inspection checklists, document scope, shipping guidance, calculators and bounded case studies. Results are references, not order-specific promises.

tools.name: validate_inquiry
tools.description: Check an HTR inquiry for product-specific missing and ambiguous fields. Returns one next question plus relevant public guides and cases. Readiness only means ready for HTR review.

tools.name: estimate_plywood_container_load
tools.description: Estimate sheets per pallet, pallet count and 20/40-foot container use for one or more bamboo panel lines. Uses conservative right-angle geometry, payload, door, stacking and forklift limits. Planning estimate only; not a loading approval or freight quotation.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare an editable HTR inquiry draft and official website confirmation link. DOES NOT submit, store the draft, send email, create a CRM record or verify an email. Collect only procurement requirements; the buyer enters contact details on the website.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_inquiry · Private data: list_product_categories, search_procurement_guides, prepare_inquiry · Public sink: prepare_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_inquiry · Private data: list_product_categories, search_procurement_guides, prepare_inquiry · Public sink: prepare_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
